variant_decisions.evidence: Qere וַיָּבֹא is Vqw3ms, ketiv ויבאו Vqw3mp, same lemma 935 with the conjunction. The subject is compound — "Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel" — and Hebrew freely takes a singular verb before it, so both readings are ordinary. The ASV's "came" is identical in both numbers and no note is mapped here, so the wording cannot separate them. Underdetermined; the base qere stands.

variant_decisions.evidence: Qere מִלִּבּוֹ is the preposition מִן on לֵב with a 3ms suffix, "of his own heart"; ketiv מלבד is מִן plus לְ on בַּד, "apart." The ASV's main text reads "the month which he had devised of his own heart," and the mapped note 1KI.12.33.n02 "Another reading is, apart." names the ketiv as the alternative. Main text and note together select the qere.
